summary: Project focused on restoring/rolling back to Version 55 as the active build and rebuilding it; prior issues involved broken Motoko backend canister configuration causing errors in admin panel, dashboard, and order placement.
architectural_notes: Admin panel, dashboard, and order placement depend on a Motoko backend canister; misconfigured/missing canister IDs cause runtime configuration error pages.
known_issues: Build/rebuild attempts for Version 58 failed due to unexpected AI/language model errors, preventing completion of the repair.

existing_features.title: Restore/roll back the project to Version 55 as the active codebase and rebuild the project from that version.

Fix the production configuration flow so the app can reliably determine the backend canister ID (via VITE_BACKEND_CANISTER_ID at build-time or via /runtime-config.json at runtime for static hosting), and ensure pages do not route to a generic error page due to missing canister ID when the runtime config is correctly set.

Update user-facing error/help text related to static hosting configuration so it references the correct deployed file path and workflow (e.g., editing the deployed runtime-config.json), and ensure the troubleshooting steps are accurate and actionable in English.

new_feature_requests.summary: Restore/roll back to Version 55 as the active project version and build it
Ensure admin panel, dashboard, and order placement work by connecting to a functioning Motoko backend canister (fix backend canister configuration error)

Ensure the dashboard, admin panel, and order placement flows function end-to-end against the Motoko backend when the backend canister ID is configured, including successful order creation from the cart/checkout flow and successful loading of user/admin order lists.

projectName: Restore Version 55 and fix backend canister configuration so dashboard, admin panel, and ordering work
